_comment: The M0-M41 reference for the SECOND sweep. M0-M40 are M40's own sweep, measured 2026-09-02 and
quoted in CAMPAIGN-BRIEF.md, unchanged. m41 is 164, measured by running `just verify-m41` under
`direnv exec` -- THIS repository's own dev shell, which is the shell the sweep uses --
`direnv exec` -- THIS repository's own dev shell -- immediately before this sweep started:
27 + 20 + 16 + 14 + 27 + 44 + 20 = 168. It was 164 before the default-flip experiment, which
left five extra assertions in verify_writer_path_is_selectable about the DEFAULT build --
which writer the runtime ships, measured on the module rather than read off the manifest,
and asserted byte-identical to one named arm and not the other. m24 is expected UNMOVED at
350: the flip is reverted, and its only red is verify_trace_event_abi_batched_faster, whose
failure count varies 14/15 run to run because it re-measures medians.
THE FIRST SWEEP MEASURED m41 AT 73, AND THE 91 MISSING WERE A DEFECT IN THIS MILESTONE.
Three of the seven checks build Nim -- two through `build_ct_print.sh`, one through
`ct-writer/build.rs` -- and this repository's dev shell did not provide `nim`. An agent's own
shell inherits the WORKSPACE's .envrc and has it; `direnv exec <this repo>` replaces PATH and
did not. So they passed by hand and died in the sweep with `nim is required`. `nim` is in
flake.nix now. M19's wasm-opt finding and M25's system-node finding are the same defect.
WHAT ADDING A TOOL TO THE SHELL CAN DO TO OTHER MILESTONES IS THE THING TO WATCH, and it is why
the whole sweep is re-run rather than m41 alone: M19 found `wasm-opt` on PATH changing m4's
result. `nim` is reached by `build_ct_print.sh`, which m24, m26 and L3 also call, so those are
the milestones where a move is expected rather than surprising -- in the direction of MORE
assertions, because those checks currently die.
Every other milestone is predicted UNMOVED. M41 vendors nothing (PROVENANCE.md unchanged at 70),
adds no pin witness in a consumer tree, adds no `| grep -q` predicate, and its REUSE-INVENTORY
footprint is zero.
